user.title: Add Video Status Monitor
user.description: Configure a camera to monitor for visual state changes.

data_description.rtsp_url: RTSP URL without credentials, e.g. rtsp://192.168.1.100:554/stream
data_description.username: Camera username (optional — leave blank for unauthenticated streams)
data_description.states: Comma-separated list of visual states to detect, e.g. open,closed,partial
data_description.scan_interval: How often to capture and analyse a frame (seconds)

api_config.title: OpenRouter API Configuration
api_config.description: Enter your OpenRouter credentials for cloud-based image analysis.

error.invalid_rtsp_url: Invalid RTSP URL — must start with rtsp:// or rtsps://
error.need_two_states: Enter at least two comma-separated states
error.missing_api_key: An API key is required for API inference mode
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the RTSP stream

data_description.roi_x: Left edge of the region of interest as a percentage of frame width (0 = left edge)
data_description.roi_y: Top edge of the region of interest as a percentage of frame height (0 = top edge)
data_description.roi_w: Width of the region of interest as a percentage of frame width (100 = full width)
data_description.roi_h: Height of the region of interest as a percentage of frame height (100 = full height)
